Dear prado team,

I'm writing to apply for the Social Media & Community Marketeer role. Your focus on invisible home technology for architects caught my attention, and I'd love to bring my digital marketing experience to your marketing team.

In my current roles at Episto and as a freelancer, I manage content across WordPress and Shopify, write SEO-driven blog posts, and use AI tools to streamline content creation. I'm fluent in English and comfortable adapting tone for different brands. While my social media experience is more embedded in broader digital campaigns, I'm eager to deepen it—especially in community management for the US market. I'm organised, proactive, and enjoy collaborating with designers and performance marketers.

I'm based in Zwijndrecht and happy to work from Ghent with weekly visits to Veurne. I'd welcome the chance to discuss how I can contribute to prado's growth.

Best regards,

cover_letter:
Dear prado team,

I'm excited to apply for the Social Media & Community Marketeer position at prado. Your mission to build invisible home technology for architects resonates with me—I appreciate how you combine R&D and strategic acquisitions to create a seamless ecosystem. I'd love to contribute to your marketing team and help grow your social presence across multiple brands and markets.

In my current roles at Episto and as a freelance digital marketer, I manage content for client websites, write SEO-driven blog posts, and use AI tools to enhance content creation. I've built and optimised WordPress and Shopify sites, ensuring brand consistency and engaging copy. While my social media management experience is more embedded in broader digital campaigns, I've integrated social media into website builds and understand the importance of community engagement. I'm fluent in English and Dutch (writing B1, speaking A2+), and I'm comfortable adapting tone of voice across brands. I'm organised, proactive, and enjoy collaborating with designers and performance marketers—skills I'm keen to apply to your US community management and content calendar.

I'm based in Zwijndrecht and open to working primarily in Ghent with one day per week in Veurne. I'm eager to learn and grow with prado, and I'm confident my digital marketing background and curiosity for social trends will make me a valuable addition to your team.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute to prado's continued growth.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
+32 470 42 48 36
baverok@gmail.com

cv_highlights:
• Digital marketing experience across SEO, content, and web, with a focus on adapting tone for different brands and markets.
• Fluent in English and Dutch (writing B1, speaking A2+), with strong writing and editing skills for social media and blog content.
• Hands-on with AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT) for content creation and optimisation, and familiar with Meta, Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok, Pinterest, and YouTube through campaign integration.
• Organised and proactive, managing multiple client projects and content calendars in WordPress and Shopify.
• Collaborative mindset, working with designers and performance marketers to align cross-channel activity and monitor engagement data.
